messages.content: Great! Let’s get started. To kick things off, can you share with me what the high-level goals are for the modernisation of the mobile app? What do you envision achieving with this project?

Honestly, I just want an app that feels more modern and works better, like Revolut. It's frustrating when I can't see what's happening with my money right away. I'd really like to know instantly when a transaction goes through. It would also be great if I could freeze my card on my own if I misplace it. Overall, I just want it to be easier to manage my finances without all the hassle.

I completely understand where you're coming from. It sounds like you’re looking for a more user-friendly experience that provides real-time updates and gives you better control over your finances. 

To clarify, when you mention wanting to see transactions instantly, can you describe what specific features you think would help with that? For example, are you looking for push notifications for each transaction?

Yeah, definitely! Push notifications would be perfect. I want to get a quick alert every time money leaves my account, you know? It should tell me how much was spent, where it went, and what I have left. Just something simple and fast, so I can keep track without having to open the app all the time.

That sounds like a very useful feature! So, to summarize, you would like the app to send push notifications for every transaction that includes details like the amount spent, the merchant, and your remaining balance. 

Now, beyond push notifications, you mentioned wanting to freeze your card. Can you explain a bit more about how you see that feature working? What would you expect it to do?

Sure! If I lose my card, I just want to be able to freeze it right away through the app, without having to call anyone or wait on hold. It should be super easy—just a button I can press. And then when I find it, I’d like to unfreeze it just as quickly. It’s all about having that control in my hands.

That makes a lot of sense! So, to confirm, you want a feature in the app that allows you to freeze and unfreeze your card with a simple button press, giving you direct control without needing to contact customer support. 

Let’s move on to some other features. You mentioned wanting to manage your finances more easily. What kind of budgeting tools or insights would you find helpful in the app? Can you give me an example of what you would like to see?

Honestly, I'd love to have some sort of breakdown of my spending each month. Like, it would be cool to see how much I spend on groceries, dining out, and stuff like that. Maybe some categories? And if I could set a budget for each category and get a heads-up when I’m getting close to going over, that would be super helpful! Just something to help me keep track of where my money is going.

That’s a great idea! To summarize, you’re looking for budgeting tools that provide a breakdown of your spending by categories, such as groceries and dining out. You’d also like the ability to set budgets for each category and receive alerts when you're nearing those budget limits. 

Now, considering all these features, are there any limitations or restrictions that we should be aware of, such as specific regulatory requirements or technical constraints?

I haven’t really thought about that. I'm just focused on what I want the app to do, like the notifications and budgeting stuff. I guess those technical details are for you guys to figure out. My main concern is just having a smooth, easy-to-use app that works well.

I appreciate your honesty! It’s definitely important to keep the user experience in mind, and we'll certainly take care of the technical aspects. 

So far, we have identified a few key requirements: 

1. Push notifications for transactions that include the amount spent, merchant, and remaining balance.
2. A feature to freeze and unfreeze your card with a simple button in the app.
3. Budgeting tools that categorize spending and allow you to set budgets, with alerts for nearing limits.

Before we wrap up, is there anything else you think is essential for the app that we haven’t discussed yet?

Hmm, let me think... I guess it would be nice if the app was really fast and easy to log into, maybe with something like fingerprint or face recognition. And having everything in one place, like my accounts and balances, would be great too—just a clean, simple view. I want to see everything I need right when I open the app without digging around. But other than that, I think we’ve covered the important stuff!

That’s a valuable addition! To summarize, you’d like the app to have a quick and easy login process, possibly using fingerprint or face recognition, as well as a clean, simple interface that displays all your accounts and balances prominently without having to search for them.

With that, I believe we have gathered enough clear requirements for the mobile app modernisation project:

1. Push notifications for transactions that include the amount spent, merchant, and remaining balance.
2. A feature to freeze and unfreeze your card with a simple button in the app.
3. Budgeting tools that categorize spending and allow you to set budgets, with alerts for nearing limits.
4. Fast and easy login options, such as fingerprint or face recognition.
5. A clean, simple interface that displays all accounts and balances prominently.
